name: fitweb-gate-v9-1
prompt: Create a NEW image, a miniature architectural scale-model diorama photographed from a high three-quarter bird's-eye angle (about 50 degrees down), soft warm morning light, clean beige studio background, 16:9. Image 1 shows the real entrance gate of Forteasia Industrial Township: copy the gate design exactly (white canopy with FORTEASIA INDUSTRIAL TOWNSHIP lettering on the front and a wooden underside; left support is a slatted grey guard block with a glass cabin, the FIT logo and a copper plaque; right support is a slim pillar wrapped in vertical rods with the round blue Forteasia F logo and the red FORTEASIA word; flags; grass beds; exactly ONE red-and-white boom barrier at the guard cabin). Do not copy image 1's camera or layout. Image 2 is the top-down site plan to follow. The whole scene is ONE flat continuous diorama base at a single ground level: in the foreground a wide six-lane public main road runs left to right across the frame, with a planted central divider; the gate stands on its far side with a T-junction and turn arrows; behind the gate the two-carriageway township road with a green median and young trees runs straight away from the camera into the distance. On the LEFT of the township road, set back behind the gate, ONE large working factory; on the RIGHT, set back behind the gate, ONE warehouse clearly SMALLER than the factory (about two thirds its length, lower roof). Both buildings stand directly on the same ground as the roads, with no raised slab or platform, and both are well separated from the gate canopy with open ground and road visible in between. Each building's long side runs parallel to the township road and its facade with the loading docks faces the township road, with a paved truck yard between facade and road joined by a driveway. Factory: grey and navy ribbed metal, saw-tooth roof with skylights and solar panels, office block at the front corner, roller-shutter bays with warm light inside, a truck backed into a bay, forklift, pallets, small workers in hi-vis. Warehouse: navy and grey ribbed metal, a row of loading docks, one open with warm light, a container truck at a dock, a forklift, a few workers. At the gate: a container truck entering through the barrier and a tipper truck leaving, both on the asphalt; a couple of cars on the main road in their lanes. The edges of the diorama fade softly into the beige background. No other text, no watermark.
